rules.title: Entry and in-time
rules.body: Hostel gates close at 10:00 PM. Late entry needs prior permission from the warden.

rules.title: Night attendance
rules.body: Attendance is taken at 10:00 PM. Residents must be in their own block.

rules.title: Visitors
rules.body: Visitors are allowed only in the visitors' room between 4:00 PM and 7:00 PM, with an entry in the visitor register.

rules.title: Electrical appliances
rules.body: Heaters, induction cooktops and kettles are not allowed in rooms. Laptops, phone chargers and table lamps are allowed.

rules.title: Leave
rules.body: Residents going home must submit a leave form signed by a parent or guardian before leaving.

rules.title: Ragging
rules.body: Ragging in any form is strictly prohibited and is a punishable offence. Report any incident to the warden or the anti-ragging committee immediately.

rules.title: Room care
rules.body: Residents are responsible for furniture and fittings in their room. Damage is charged to the residents of that room.

rules.title: Quiet hours
rules.body: Quiet hours are from 11:00 PM to 6:00 AM. Use headphones for music and calls.

faqs.q: How do I change my room?
faqs.a: Submit a room-change request to your block warden. Changes are usually done only at the start of a semester, subject to availability.

faqs.q: Can I stay in the hostel during vacations?
faqs.a: Yes, if you fill the stay-back form before the deadline mentioned in the vacation circular. Only some blocks may stay open.

faqs.q: What if I miss a meal?
faqs.a: Meals are not refunded for single missed meals. For long leave, ask the mess office about the mess-rebate rule.

faqs.q: How do I get a guest room for my parents?
faqs.a: Apply to the hostel office at least 3 days in advance. Guest rooms are limited and given first-come, first-served.

faqs.q: Who do I contact if I feel unwell at night?
faqs.a: Inform your block warden or security desk immediately. For emergencies, call your college's emergency number or 112.
A laundry service collects clothes from each block on Monday and Thursday mornings. Charges are per piece.

contacts.where: Hostel Office, Block A, Ground Floor

complaint_steps.title: Describe the problem
complaint_steps.body: Note the block, room number, what is broken (fan, light, tap, furniture, Wi-Fi) and since when.

complaint_steps.title: Take a photo
complaint_steps.body: A clear photo helps the maintenance team bring the right tools.

complaint_steps.title: Register the complaint
complaint_steps.body: Use your hostel's maintenance portal or register at the Maintenance Desk. Keep the complaint number.

complaint_steps.title: Follow up
complaint_steps.body: If it isn't fixed in 48 hours, inform your block warden with the complaint number.

complaint_steps.title: Escalate if needed
complaint_steps.body: For safety issues (exposed wires, water leaks near sockets), report to the warden immediately, not just online.
